question: Estimate the staff/agents needed for an EdTech company running 1L+ live online classes per day.
idealClarificationQuestions: Live tutoring company (e.g., PhysicsWallah, BYJU'S Live, Vedantu)? Yes.
Both teachers + supporting ops staff (TA, doubt solvers, content)? Yes — total instructional staff.
1 lakh class sessions per day (industry-leader scale)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Daily classes / classes per instructor + support staff ratio.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Live teachers needed: 1L / 4 = 25,000 active teaching slots/day. Considering teacher rotation across 5 weekdays = ~20K-22K teachers on payroll.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 1L / 4 = 25,000 active teaching slots/day. Considering teacher rotation across 5 weekdays = ~20K-22K teachers on payroll.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus TAs / doubt solvers / chat moderators

calculationFlow: Average teacher delivers: ~3-5 live classes/day (with prep + recording overlap).
Live teachers needed: 1L / 4 = 25,000 active teaching slots/day. Considering teacher rotation across 5 weekdays = ~20K-22K teachers on payroll.
Plus TAs / doubt solvers / chat moderators: ~1 TA per 2 classes = 12,500.
